title: Amneal and Adalvo Announce FDA Acceptance for Review of Two U.S. ANDAs for Generic Tirzepatide Autoinjector
summary: Companies jointly advance development and planned U.S. commercialisation of generic tirzepatide injection, subject to FDA approval BRIDGEWATER, N.J., July 8, 2026 Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMRX) and Adalvo announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has accepted for review two Abbreviated New Drug Applications (ANDAs) filed at NCE-1 for generic tirzepatide injection in the United States. The two ANDAs, referencing Mounjaro(r) (autoinjector) and Zepbound(r) (autoinjector), seek approval for single-dose prefilled pen presentations of the respective reference products for all currently approved indications, including the treatment of type 2 diabetes and chronic weight management, including for adults with obesity and adults with moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).
